mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4; tolterodine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing progesterone levels, while progesterone may induce CYP3A4 affecting tolterodine metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased progesterone-related effects (e.g., sedation, breakthrough bleeding) and tolterodine efficacy; consider dose adjustment or alternative antimuscarinergic if significant interaction suspected.
